capability: Verified OAuth account chain to real invitation membership

test.fixture: Synthetic signed HS256 tokens; isolated pg-mem database; real token verifier, account-link resolution, REST router, control service and room persistence
checks: Wrong signature, unlinked subject, insufficient scope and forged profile do not change membership.
Linked guest joins once and repeated idempotency key returns current membership.
Guest role remains participant, media consents remain false and runtime remains idle.
No browser cookie, invitation plaintext, access token or answer authority appears in the join response.
Revoked account link prevents replay using the previously valid token.
Desktop guard independently rejects a valid room token without its native session.
Existing signed REST/MCP read parity and account-link revocation test also passes.

connection_gaps: Native account-link default scopes authorize Friends & Parties, not Shared Live Rooms.
Local account-link persistence does not establish an OAuth link on another service; domain coordination cookies do not replace it.
Installed general REST remains behind the desktop session guard; native guest transport must preserve that boundary and reach the same room/runtime/task authority.
not_proven: Remote owner task binding, instruction delivery and results
Guest mission denial, live media, reconnect and interruption
Earlier release-evaluator Casimir PASS, certificate or integrity
runtime_changes: None; no rebuild, deployment, new network exposure, provider configuration or paid call
